description.value:
Requirement Drift 9 (Chrome-Bound)

Duration constant

At Chrome-Bound Drift, your Rig quietly keeps you running when your own hardware can't.

There's a line running from the Rig to you that isn't on any schematic. At Drift 9 (Chrome-Bound), if all your augments are ever suppressed at once — EMP, a dead reservoir, a GM effect — your Rig's own power keeps your systems live: you do not become sickened 2, and your nanite dependency does not otherwise trigger, so long as your Rig remains active and nearby. If your Rig is destroyed or shut down at the same time, this protection lapses with it.

cinderfall.incomplete: [DRIFT-NO-SCHEMA] (the Drift-9 gate) + [RIG-GENERIC-AMBIGUOUS] (the "Rig active and nearby" condition) + no roll-option for "all your augments are suppressed at once" either. Three independent unencodable predicates stacked on one card.
